plan.purpose: semantic reconstruction and engine-contract fidelity, not a win-rate experiment
plan.independence: Fresh semantic derivation and lowering from raw baseline+engine; shared AST parser; same agent/session, not blind. No existing IR or lowering imported by independent_ir.py.
plan.roster: all ten seats use original baseline or independent regeneration, paired by seed
plan.acceptance: Exact whole-program AST equality; 500 randomized real-VM cases; full action/state tapes identical on both complete seeds; controlled real-engine temporal probes pass. No competitive claim or league update from an equivalent reconstruction.

amendment.reason: Added source-grounded immediate equipment HP/mana effect and a fifth controlled probe; corrected initial fixture to preserve the class maximum HP. No behavior, full-game seed, parity threshold or win criterion changed.

temporal_facts.self_data: self* and worldTick are set once before each hero's VM decision; use/buy do not refresh them.
temporal_facts.queries: object* and item* query current engine state at the call; visibility still filters objects.
temporal_facts.inventory_flags: Presence and empty-slot flags accumulate before useItem for each slot. They are earlier observations, not current post-use/post-buy inventory.
temporal_facts.gold: All affordability guards read starting selfGold; each buyItem checks and spends the remaining live balance.
temporal_facts.equipment: Successful purchases refresh stats: increases in maximum HP/mana also add that increase to current HP/mana. Resource gear therefore has immediate sustain effects as well as permanent capacity.
temporal_facts.attack: attackTarget stores an engine pursuit target if valid; accepted does not prove path reachability or damage.
temporal_facts.walk: walkTo clears attack intent before pathfinding, including when pathfinding subsequently returns false.
temporal_facts.poison: useItem on poison strikes the engine's current attackObjectId, not a policy-local bestId variable.
temporal_facts.failures: A command return of zero does not universally mean no state changed. Failed walkTo can clear attack intent.
temporal_facts.memory: Policy globals persist; baseline resets its decision-local scan variables. Engine attack/movement intent is separate persistent state.

conclusion: The independent IR is behaviorally equivalent to baseline. Existing baseline IR was faithful; current variants differ in explicit tested choices. Richer temporal/effect semantics and parent-free baseline lifting are incorporated; no strength improvement is claimed.
